fullReasoning.en: UNI suffered a decisive breakdown, shedding 18% over seven days to $7.45. The core problem isn't sentiment—it's arithmetic. Annualized buybacks of $14.63M (17% of $86M protocol revenue) only retire 1.96M UNI at current price versus 20M fixed annual emission. Net inflation sits at +2.03%/year, obliterating the post-fee-switch burn narrative that fueled earlier rallies. The market is repricing this structural flaw. Context matters: $7.45 represents a 25% premium to the $5.96 treasury burn anchor, where the DAO burned 100M tokens and effectively marked its own fair value baseline. That level exerts gravitational pull. TVL declined 2.25% in lockstep with price, confirming no fundamental bid at these levels. Derivatives positioning adds fuel: long/short ratio of 1.92 with flat funding (+0.01%) is textbook overleveraged-longs setup before cascading stops. The path of least resistance points toward mean reversion to $5.96 or below, where burn math improves materially (2.93M annual at $5 vs 1.96M now). Absent a doubling of protocol revenue or emission cuts, UNI cannot sustainably hold premiums above its cost anchor. Watch for capitulation wicks into the $5-5.50 zone where institutional accumulation historically occurred.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI遭遇决定性破位,七日暴跌18%至$7.45。核心问题不在情绪而在算术:年化回购预算$1463万(协议收入$8605万的17%)在当前价格下仅能销毁196万枚UNI,而年固定增发2000万枚。净通胀率+2.03%年化,彻底摧毁了推动此前反弹的费用开关后销毁叙事。市场正在重新定价这一结构性缺陷。关键语境:$7.45较$5.96国库销毁锚定价高出25%——DAO通过从国库销毁1亿枚代币,实质性标定了自身公允价值基线。该水平形成引力中心。TVL与价格同步下跌2.25%,确认当前位置无基本面买盘支撑。衍生品持仓火上浇油:多空比1.92配合持平资金费率(+0.01%)是典型的多头过度杠杆化特征,随时引发连锁止损。最小阻力路径指向均值回归至$5.96或更低,该价位下销毁数学显著改善(年化293万枚 vs 当前196万枚)。除非协议收入翻倍或削减增发,UNI无法持续维持高于成本锚定价的溢价。关注$5-5.50区间的投降式插针,该区域历史上是机构建仓带。
